sloka: इक्ष्वाकूणां वरिष्ठस्य रामस्य विदितात्मनः ।शुभानि धर्मयुक्तानि वचनानि समर्पयन् ।। ५.३०.४२।।।।
transliteration: ikṣvākūṇāṁ variṣṭhasya rāmasya viditātmanaḥ ।śubhāni dharmayuktāni vacanāni samarpayan ।। 5.30.42।।।।

translations.english: "I shall present in auspicious words the esteemed Rama of Ikshvaku family who is a knower of self and make her listen to everything in such a sweet manner that she will trust me.
